components.name: Base Button
components.description: Default action: page fill, hairline border, ink text.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-size: 13px; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2d33); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg, #131417); color: var(--fg, #e8eaed); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, border-color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--row-bg-hover, #26282c); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #E5FF44); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Strongest through contrast, never accent: ink-filled.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--fg, #e8eaed); color: var(--bg, #131417); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--on-fg, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #E5FF44); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Label + control: quiet focus, no glow.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg-muted, #9aa0a6); } .ds-req { color: var(--accent, #E5FF44); } .ds-field-control { font-size: 13px; color: var(--fg, #e8eaed); background: var(--bg, #131417); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2d33); border-radius: 6px; padding: 7px 10px; height: 32px; } .ds-field-control:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--fg-muted, #9aa0a6); } .ds-field-control::placeholder { color: var(--fg-muted, #9aa0a6); }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.html: Explorer
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--fg, #e8eaed); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13.5px; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out, color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: var(--row-bg-hover, #26282c); } .ds-sidebar-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #E5FF44); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Listing Row
components.description: The app's atom: file row with typed icon hue and mono metadata.
components.html: metrics.parquet4.2 MB
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; color: var(--fg, #e8eaed); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 80ms ease-out; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--row-bg-hover, #26282c); } .ds-row-name { flex: 1; } .ds-row-meta { color: var(--fg-muted, #9aa0a6); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Card Thumb
components.description: Thumbnail card: hairline only; hover tints border toward accent.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; width: 200px; padding: 0; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; color: var(--fg, #e8eaed); font-size: 13px; } .ds-card-thumb { aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: var(--bg-alt, #1b1d21); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2d33); border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-thumb { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #E5FF44) 55%, var(--border, #2a2d33)); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-name { color: var(--accent-soft, #c9d95e); }

narrative.overview: fused-render is a dark cockpit for your own machine: quiet chrome, hairline seams, utility density, and one lime signal. The interface is confident and dark-first — the dark palette IS the app's identity, and light mode is a faithful, per-token translation of the same relationships, never a restyle. The system runs on semantic colour discipline: every hue means something. The Fused Lime accent is rare and earned — focus rings, selection, the occasional highlight — never a button fill or a large surface. Hierarchy is carried by contrast, spacing, and hairline borders, not by colour weight.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first; light is a byte-faithful translation, not a second design
Quiet, precise, dense — 13–14px UI type, 32px controls, hairline borders
One accent (Fused Lime), used sparingly; neutral-filled primary buttons
Every colour is a named token with a defined role; semantic hues form a learned vocabulary
Flat-first: borders carry separation, shadows stay minimal and ambient

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Fused Lime never fills a button or a large surface; it marks focus, selection, and the rare highlight. Primary actions read strongest through contrast (ink-filled), not accent.

rules.name: The Token Rule
rules.body: Every colour comes from tokens.css. A hardcoded colour is a colour light mode cannot repaint.

rules.name: The Scrim Exception
rules.body: Controls sitting on arbitrary pixels (images, maps, video) use the --scrim-* set — identical in both themes, white ink on dark wash — because the surface underneath is not ours.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: There is no display face. Headings differentiate by weight and spacing within the system stack; nothing is decorative.

rules.name: The Drawn-Edge Rule
rules.body: If two surfaces must read as separate, give them a Hairline border or an ordered fill — never a heavier shadow.

dos: Do take every colour from tokens.css; add a token (with a light counterpart) before adding a colour.
Do keep controls at 32px, radius at 6px, and UI type at 13–14px.
Do use --activity for in-flight/unread signals and the status hues for outcomes; keep hue meanings stable.
Do carry hierarchy with contrast and Hairline borders; keep primary buttons ink-filled.
Do pick one of the three motion durations; never invent a new number.
donts: Don't fill buttons or large surfaces with Fused Lime — accent everywhere is the confirmed anti-reference; accent is for focus and selection.
Don't import generic SaaS decoration: gradient heroes, glassmorphism, decorative card shadows.
Don't play terminal cosplay: no scanlines, phosphor glow, or faux-CRT styling — developer-native means quiet, not themed.
Don't hardcode a colour, restyle dark mode, or give a dark token no light counterpart.
Don't use heavier shadows to separate surfaces; draw the edge instead.
